blockers.description: Live animation (rAF and CSS keyframes) could not be observed. The Claude Browser pane is collapsed, so document.hidden is true and requestAnimationFrame delivers 0 frames per second. Measured directly, not assumed.
blockers.workaround: Wiring was verified indirectly instead: stepParallax is unit-tested; the CSS translate was measured at 0 -> 0px, 0.5 -> -249.75px, 0.999 -> -499px against a 499.5px tile (a seamless wrap); the bank transform matrix was confirmed as exactly rotate(-14deg) x scale(1.4); the snow carrier column measured 666px against a 666px window. A human must open http://localhost:5173 in a normal browser window to confirm motion actually flows.

decisions.decision: Paper only — no text editor anywhere in the app
decisions.rationale: Armaan writes essays by hand; the app is a companion around the writing, not a place to do it. This reshapes every other feature.
Armaan explicitly rejected live generation: wanted 'creative not ai slop' where each prompt teaches something real. 60 excellent prompts beat infinite mediocre ones.

decisions.decision: Seed shown up front, depth layer withheld until review
decisions.rationale: The steelman, reading list and trap would contaminate the writer's own thinking if visible beforehand. Withholding preserves the exercise while still teaching.

decisions.decision: Three lanes with separate prompts, guidance and rubrics
decisions.rationale: A personal statement and a Rawls essay are different crafts; one shared rubric would be wrong half the time.

decisions.decision: Only the prompt actually written is consumed
decisions.rationale: Passed-over prompts return to the pool, so 60 prompts lasts ~5 months at 3/week rather than burning 3 per roll.

decisions.decision: Weekly goal chain instead of a daily streak
decisions.rationale: A daily streak snapping after a strong run is demoralising; a weekly chain rewards consistency without punishing one busy day.

decisions.decision: Weather selectable in Settings; scenery left automatic
decisions.rationale: Armaan chose Settings-controlled weather. Scenery stayed automatic because the surprise of what you are flying over is worth more than the control, and it keeps Settings uncluttered.

decisions.decision: Photos stored as {type, bytes: ArrayBuffer}, not as Blobs
decisions.rationale: Blobs do not survive IndexedDB structured-clone in jsdom, and historically not in Safari. Storing bytes is both testable and safer.

decisions.decision: Every non-trivial Zen behaviour lives in a pure, tested module
decisions.rationale: scenery, weather, banking, parallax, journey and random are pure so correctness never depends on watching the screen — which turned out to matter, since the pane cannot show motion.

next_action: Open http://localhost:5173 in a real browser window, start a session, and enter Zen mode to confirm the animation flows. Then write one essay against a Sharpener prompt and one against a Full essay prompt to judge whether the seed-then-depth format holds at both lengths.
context_notes: This project was NOT built through GSD phases — there is no .planning/phases structure, so this handoff uses the workflow's default context. The durable state is CLAUDE.md (architecture, conventions and five hard-won gotchas), README.md (what it is and how to run it), 131 passing tests, and two commits on main. A resuming agent should read CLAUDE.md first; it is more reliable than any summary of this conversation. The work is at a natural stopping point: tree is clean, everything builds, nothing is half-finished.
